details:
All 8 acceptance criteria verified:
1. Chore model fields: title (CharField max_length=200, required), due_date (DateField, required), assignee (CharField max_length=100, blank=True, default=''), notes (TextField, blank=True, default=''), priority (CharField with Low/Medium/High choices, blank=True, default=''), tags (ManyToManyField to Tag, blank=True), completed (BooleanField default=False) — all present and correct.
2. Tag model exists with name field (CharField unique=True) and __str__ returns name — verified.
3. Initial migration 0001_initial.py exists under chores/migrations/ creating Chore, Tag, and M2M join table — verified.
4. `python manage.py migrate` applies cleanly with no errors; showmigrations confirms [X] 0001_initial (no pending migrations) — verified.
5. Chore.objects.create(title='Wash dishes', due_date='2025-01-15') persists to database — test_create_chore_with_required_fields passes.
6. Omitting title raises ValidationError (test_title_required); omitting due_date raises IntegrityError (test_due_date_required); omitting assignee/notes/priority/tags is allowed (respective tests pass) — verified.
7. Chore.__str__ returns title; Tag.__str__ returns name — both tests pass.
8. Tags can be created and assigned via M2M (chore.tags.add(tag)) and queried bidirectionally (tag1.chore_set.all()) — test_m2m_tags_bidirectional passes.

All 6 testing-guidelines scenarios for Chore Model are also covered: blank title validation, blank due_date validation, priority default, completed default, string representation, and due_date ordering.
